title: Corrosion Analysis Chamber
description: A chemistry lab workstation where the DamagedHelmet serves as a corroded metal specimen under analysis, placed on the coffeemat which acts as a reactive chemical absorption pad. The user must apply a sequence of chemical reagents to different damaged zones of the helmet, monitor pH levels on the pad, and document corrosion patterns through an interactive multi-step forensic chemistry workflow.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with es-module-shims) implementing an interactive corrosion analysis lab. Load DamagedHelmet.glb centered at (0, 1.2, 0) scaled to 1.5x as the corroded specimen. Load coffeemat.glb at (0, 0, 0) scaled to 3x as the chemical absorption pad beneath it. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0, 2.5, 4) looking at origin with OrbitControls. Add a DirectionalLight from (3, 5, 2) intensity 1.5, a HemisphereLight (0xffffff, 0x444444, 0.6), and a PointLight at (-2, 3, 1) with warm color 0xffaa44 intensity 0.8 to simulate a lab lamp. Create an HTML overlay panel showing: current reagent selector (6 reagents: HCl, NaOH, H2SO4, acetone, distilled water, phenolphthalein), a pH meter display (0-14 scale with color bar), a corrosion log textarea, and a progress tracker showing steps completed out of 8. The 8 required interaction steps are: (1) click helmet to select first damage zone — highlight it with emissive overlay, (2) select HCl reagent and click Apply — animate a green particle drip effect onto the zone, (3) observe pH change on the pad — coffeemat material tint shifts toward red and pH reads 2.1, (4) click a second damage zone on the helmet, (5) apply NaOH — animate blue particles, pH shifts to 11.3 and pad tints blue, (6) apply phenolphthalein indicator — pad surface flashes pink via emissive pulse animation, (7) click 'Neutralize' button — animate distilled water wash with white particles resetting pad color and pH to 7.0, (8) click 'Log Results' to auto-populate the corrosion log with zone data and timestamp. Use raycasting for helmet clicks. Validate each step must occur in order — disable out-of-sequence buttons. Show a completion banner with confetti-style particle burst when all 8 steps finish. Add subtle helmet rotation animation (0.002 rad/frame on Y) when idle.
